ai: AI = BibleAIPromptSection nudge card (sectionOrder 'ai_prompt', HomeScreen.tsx:2918) with congregation-specific copy at sections/BibleAIPromptSection.tsx:24-28 ('Go deeper with Bible AI' / 'Ask questions about today's reading, get historical context, or explore how it applies to your life.'). It self-hides permanently once localStorage dw_behavior_v1 contains any event type==='ai_prompt' (BibleAIPromptSection.tsx:3-12), with no UI to bring it back. Opening it (or the ReadingActionBar 'Ask AI' button, ReadingActionBar.tsx:45, or search) all drive one shared <BibleAI> modal instance (HomeScreen.tsx:4586-4593, isOpen={showBibleAI}), receiving currentPassage/selectedText/initialQuestion. GreekHebrewPopup is another possible entry to the same modal but is gated pf.greekHebrew !== 'hidden' (HomeScreen.tsx:4583-4585), and congregation's greekHebrew feature is 'hidden' (persona-config.ts:345), so that entry point is off for this persona. The system prompt addition sent to the AI for congregation is defined at persona-config.ts:372-375: "The user is a church member growing in their faith. Give thorough but accessible answers. Avoid heavy academic language unless they specifically ask. Focus on practical application and daily life." (Indonesian translation at line 374).
audio: Hero audio is a single persistent player keyed HERO_KEY = '__hero__' (HomeScreen.tsx:995) playing whichever chapter is heroChapterRefs[heroChapterIndex] (heroChapterRefs computed at HomeScreen.tsx:1291 as the union of plan passages + visible reading slots). Congregation's sectionOrder lists 'hero_audio' (persona-config.ts:338) but this is not an explicit string-gate in HomeScreen.tsx — the hero block renders unconditionally as core UI. A background effect (HomeScreen.tsx:945-960) preloads/caches TTS audio per chapter+translation once text is available, slicing text to 20000 chars (a shorter slice previously cut audio off ~1/3 into long chapters, per comment). AP.playUrl(HERO_KEY, src) starts playback (HomeScreen.tsx:1533). On natural end of the LAST chapter (result==='ended'), if dw_reading_done isn't already stamped for today, it defers to handleMarkRead (HomeScreen.tsx:1560-1571) — listening through the whole reading completes the day and credits streak/plan; a mid-list chapter ending only calls markPlanDayComplete, not the full day-complete flow. ReadingActionBar.tsx:31-37 exposes the listen/pause toggle while a chapter is expanded.
completion_and_streak: Two paths stamp completion, both idempotent per calendar day via localStorage dw_reading_done (en-CA date string). (1) Explicit tap: handleMarkRead(passage) at HomeScreen.tsx:719-732 early-returns if dw_reading_done already equals today; otherwise it stamps dw_reading_done, calls markPlanDayComplete(passage), completeTodaysPathwayDay(passage), recordStreakToday(), sets readDoneToday true, fires a haptic, and shows either a plan-finish celebration or setDoneCelebration(getStreak().count). (2) Audio completion: HomeScreen.tsx:1560-1571 — only when the LAST chapter's audio reaches natural end AND dw_reading_done isn't already stamped does it setTimeout-defer to handleMarkRead; earlier chapters ending mid-list only credit the plan day, not the streak/day stamp. recordStreakToday()/getStreak() live in src/utils/streak.ts, imported at HomeScreen.tsx:38, and are documented idempotent per day (comment at line 543).
first_visit: Congregation auto-starts today's Daily Word (Ashley & Jane) reading once: HomeScreen.tsx:977-990, gated on personaConfig.persona==='congregation', checks the one-time flag dw_aj_autostarted and empty dw_activeplans/readingSlots, then seeds dw_activeplans['ashley-jane-daily-word'] and sets dw_aj_autostarted='1' — a later quit of the plan is respected as a fill, not a re-enrol. On the first-visit calendar day (dw_first_open missing or equal to today, HomeScreen.tsx:449-453) the streak chip is suppressed even though streakCount would read 1, to avoid a false "1 day" for a brand-new user. A one-time PathArrivalStrip (HomeScreen.tsx:2095-2100) renders if pathArrival state is set, i.e. right after "Choose your path" saved a new path.
return_visit: Greeting text recomputes on mount via getGreeting(persona, firstName, getStreak().count, lang) (HomeScreen.tsx:172-175); the congregation branch varies by streak bucket (streak>7 / streak>1 / else — Spanish example at persona-config.ts:126-131, parallel Portuguese ~163-168, Indonesian block from ~200). The streak chip shows once streakCount>0 and it's past the first-visit day (HomeScreen.tsx:2006), with milestone thresholds [1,2,3,5,7,10,14,21,30,40,60,90,100,180,365] (HomeScreen.tsx:2007) and a tappable milestone modal at streak>=7 (HomeScreen.tsx:2010-2013). readDoneToday state re-reads dw_reading_done against today's en-CA date on mount (HomeScreen.tsx:458).

summary: The congregation path's declared sectionOrder is [greeting, hero_audio, scripture, ai_prompt, campus_count] (persona-config.ts:336-342), but only 'scripture' and 'ai_prompt' are actually gated by that array in HomeScreen.tsx; 'greeting' and 'hero_audio' render unconditionally as core hero UI, and 'campus_count' is a dead entry whose render code was deliberately removed (comment HomeScreen.tsx:3423-3427). Congregation auto-starts the Ashley & Jane Daily Word plan once on a fresh install (HomeScreen.tsx:977-990). Completion/streak stamps via localStorage dw_reading_done + recordStreakToday(), fired either by an explicit 'Mark as read' tap (handleMarkRead, HomeScreen.tsx:719-732) or by hero audio playing through to the end of the last chapter (HomeScreen.tsx:1560-1571); both paths are idempotent per calendar day. Audio is a single HERO_KEY player with background TTS preloading (HomeScreen.tsx:945-995,1533). AI is the BibleAIPromptSection nudge (persona-specific copy, self-hiding after first use, BibleAIPromptSection.tsx) feeding a shared BibleAI modal, with a congregation-specific systemPromptAddition (persona-config.ts:372-375); the GreekHebrewPopup entry to that modal is off for congregation since greekHebrew is 'hidden'. Word of the Day is hidden for congregation (wordOfDay:'hidden'). CongregationStatsSection.tsx exists but is unused anywhere in HomeScreen.tsx. No test file currently covers the congregation persona's hero-reading behaviour.
